body_markdown:
The auto market is constantly evolving. Stay ahead of the curve with our third annual 2025 Vehicle Accessibility Report. Read the report to learn more about:


- **Shifting Consumer Trends:** How are rising costs, interest rates, and limited inventory are impacting purchase decisions across different credit tiers.
- **Generational Differences:** How different generations are searching for auto loans and financing auto purchases.
- **The Consumer Journey:** Analysis of the financial outlook, credit awareness, and the path to vehicle ownership.


[Download the report here](https://go.openlending.com/var2025-web) .
